Main behaviors:
- get: check whether it's expired (clock() >= expiry) → delete and return the default value. On hit: move_to_end.
- put: first remove expired entries, then insert/replace with move_to_end, then evict LRU until len <= capacity.
- len: count entries that haven't expired. Should it also delete expired ones? In test_len_counts_live_only, "a" not in c and "b" in c after len(c)==1. `in` also needs to check expiry. Deleting expired entries during len() is optional, but doing so makes things consistent. Be careful: len must not change the order of entries that haven't expired. Deleting expired ones is fine.

"old" was put at 0, expires at 5, expired by t=6. put("new") at t=6 first removes expired ones (removes "old"), leaving live+new = 2 ≤ capacity 2. Good.

Edge case: expiry comparison — entries expire when clock() >= t + ttl. Use >= for the expired check.

Eviction order in put: remove expired entries, then evict LRU until at most capacity entries remain. When replacing an existing key, size doesn't change, so eviction isn't needed unless expired removal already brought it within capacity.

key -> (value, expiry) where expiry is None for entries that never expire\n        self._data = OrderedDict()\n\n    def _expiry(self):\n        if self.ttl is None:\n            return None\n        return self.clock() + self.ttl\n\n    def _is_expired(self, expiry):\n        return expiry is not None and self.clock() >= expiry\n\n    def _drop_expired(self):\n        if self.ttl is None:\n            return\n        now = self.clock()\n        expired = [k for k, (_, expiry) in self._data.items()\n                   if expiry is not None and now >= expiry]\n        for k in expired:\n            del self._data[k]\n\n    def get(self, key, default=None):\n        try:\n            value, expiry = self._data[key]\n        except KeyError:\n            return default\n        if self._is_expired(expiry):\n            del self._data[key]\n            return default\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\n        return value\n\n    def put(self, key, value):\n        self._drop_expired()\n        self._data[key] = (value, self._expiry())\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\n        while len(self._data) > self.capacity:\n            self._data.popitem(last=False)\n\n    def __len__(self):\n        if self.ttl is None:\n            return len(self._data)\n        now = self.clock()\n        return sum(1 for _, expiry in self._data.values()\n                   if expiry is None or now < expiry)\n\n    def __contains__(self, key):\n        entry = self._data.get(key)\n        if entry is None:\n            return False\n        return not self._is_expired(entry[1])\n"}"]]}
